findings.title: Tool runs work but do not feel natural yet
findings.detail: Probe 2026-10-12: ten plain-language requests (no tool names) against qwen3-coder:30b on walter with 21 tools selected, through an isolated test router whose only root was the self-edit clone. Five answered well (code lookup 58 s, git history, repo status, time conversion, plus the earlier approved edit). Failures: (1) cluster question: the model guessed node names node1-3 in parallel with cluster.status; two "Node alias is not configured" errors spent the error budget of 2 and the run ended with no answer although cluster.status succeeded. (2) calc.eval: from_unit and to_unit are required even for plain arithmetic (spec() marks every property required); both attempts failed and the run ended with no answer. (3) md.outline: guessed tools/setup-guide.md, got File not found, and asked the user instead of looking. (4) web: answered from web.search snippets without web.read and invented release details. (5) secret.scan takes text only; the model scanned an invented sentence and then claimed it had no file access.
